name: Light Leak
desc: Analog film light leaks bleed in from the frame edges — soft slow washes of warm orange and magenta, an over-exposure bar sliding across, and a faint emulsion-grain flicker; the classic broad, glowing edge-bloom laid additively over any footage.

style.doc: super8=warm orange/amber / ektachrome=magenta-cyan cross-process / halation=red bloom / prism=rainbow spectral / bw_fog=silver over-exposure fog
